## Statistical Rethinking

In 2026, I followed along the first 10 lectures of Richard McElreath's fantastic [*Statistical Rethinking*](https://github.com/rmcelreath/stat_rethinking_2026/tree/main) course.
Here you can see some of my attempts to solving the exercises.

:::{#bayes}

## Meta-analysis & Visualization

In my last project I worked on comparing frequentist and Bayesian meta-analytic frameworks and I ran into an issue: The very pretty and convenient `forest()` function from the `metafor`package is not very open to adding things like posterior distributions...
